summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP filed a routine Form 6-K containing its quarterly report for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing covers standard financial disclosures including preferred unit distributions, sale-leaseback arrangements with China Development Bank Financial Leasing Co., and general partner distribution tiers. No special-situation transaction is present: there is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private proposal, activist stake, strategic review, spin-off, or forced management change. The 6-K is an ordinary current report furnished by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, premiums, or board recommendations are stated. No risk-arb angle applies.
